payload.text: {"summary":"The geckoterminal app was already curated (10 user-centric tools, domain PREAMBLE, seed test.json), so this pass verified it against the aomi-app-ux-tool-maker checklist and closed the one real coverage gap: the token 'info' endpoint carrying rug/honeypot risk signals. Verified the generated client round-trips reproducibly via `ab gen-client geckoterminal --force` (formatting-only diff, identical types/fields/methods), then trimmed UI-only fields (image, image_url, banner_image_url, gt_categories_id) from the token_info schema at the spec layer and regenerated the app-local client. Added an 11th tool, geckoterminal_check_token_safety (args: network, token_address), wrapping GET /networks/{network}/tokens/{address}/info — returns GT score with breakdown, honeypot flag, holder count and top-holder concentration, mint/freeze authority, developer holding %, and socials/websites as risk signals. Updated PREAMBLE with the new capability line and workflow guidance (offer a safety check before the user acts on a new/trending token, present results as signals not verdicts) and registered the tool in dyn_aomi_app!. cargo build is green; live smoke of the info endpoint confirmed the API shape (serde silently drops the trimmed fields from richer live JSON). Existing test.json user_story preserved per skill guidance. No ext/ files were needed — the client is app-local. Final tool set: list_networks, get_trending_pools, get_top_pools, get_new_pools, search_pools, get_pool, get_pool_ohlcv, get_pool_trades, get_token, get_token_price, check_token_safety.","changedFiles":"apps/geckoterminal/openapi.yaml (trimmed token_info schema); apps/geckoterminal/openapi.preprocessed.yaml (regenerated); apps/geckoterminal/src/client/client.rs + mod.rs (regenerated from trimmed spec); apps/geckoterminal/src/tool.rs (added CheckTokenSafety tool, updated header doc); apps/geckoterminal/src/lib.rs (PREAMBLE capability + workflow guidance, registered tool)","followUps":"Run /aomi-app-e2e-tester geckoterminal to expand test.json into a full multi-turn spec and verify end-to-end; optionally smoke-chat via aomi-run target/debug/libgeckoterminal.dylib to sanity-check tool naming/PREAMBLE wording; consider a future tool over /tokens/info_recently_updated if a 'newly profiled tokens' user story emerges. All work is uncommitted in the working tree for Cecilia's review (whole apps/geckoterminal/ dir is untracked)."}
